Corrected an issue where a player could talk to Vaelastrasz the Corrupted before Nefarian had finished his speach, causing both events to overlap.

Corrected an issue on Vaelastrasz the Corrupted that caused Rift of Corruption not to spawn.

Bladestorm PVP mod not being applied properly.
